video_title: PERO ANTIĆ: NBA epizoda i HAPŠENJE u New York-u!

quotes.speaker: Pero Antić
quotes.summary_phrase: Pero Antić on his NBA career and Mike Budenholzer
quotes.excerpt: I talked to Mike Budenholzer. I was 31 years old, and I wanted to play, not just sit.
quotes.quote: I told Mike Budenholzer that he was going to make me retire at 31 years old. I wanted to play, not just sit on the bench. I wanted to talk to the coach, and I did. I was honest with him about my situation and what I wanted from my career.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Rekao sam Majku Budenholzeru da će me naterati da se penzionišem sa 31 godinom. Hteo sam da igram, a ne samo da sedim na klupi. Hteo sam da razgovaram sa trenerom i jesam. Bio sam iskren prema njemu o mojoj situaciji i šta želim od svoje karijere.

quotes.speaker: Pero Antić
quotes.summary_phrase: Pero Antić on the Miami Heat vs San Antonio Spurs finals
quotes.excerpt: I read in the news that the San Antonio Spurs were idiots for not making a foul.
quotes.quote: I didn't watch the finals, but I read the news. The San Antonio Spurs were idiots for not making a foul when Ray Allen hit that shot from the corner. It was a huge mistake that cost them the series.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Nisam gledao finale, ali sam čitao vesti. San Antonio Spursi su bili idioti što nisu napravili faul kada je Rej Alen pogodio onu trojku iz ugla. To je bila ogromna greška koja ih je koštala serije.

quotes.speaker: Pero Antić
quotes.summary_phrase: Pero Antić on the 'Al Harrington' incident
quotes.excerpt: Al Harrington told me, 'Pero, you're my rookie.' I said, 'What? I'm not a rookie.'
quotes.quote: Dennis Schröder gave me a baby to carry, and we were sitting in the locker room. Someone asked if Lou Williams said something about Al Harrington, Jeff Teague, and Lou Williams. The next day, someone brought it up, and I raised my head. Al Harrington said, 'Pero, you're my rookie.' I said, 'What? I'm not a rookie.' He just laughed and said he was just joking.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Denis Šreder mi je dao bebu da nosim, a mi smo sedeli u svlačionici. Neko je pitao da li je Lu Vilijams rekao nešto o Al Haringtonu, Džef Tigu i Lu Vilijamsu. Sutradan je neko to pomenuo, a ja sam podigao glavu. Al Harington je rekao: 'Pero, ti si moj ruki.' Ja sam rekao: 'Šta? Ja nisam ruki.' On se samo nasmejao i rekao da se samo šali.

quotes.speaker: Pero Antić
quotes.summary_phrase: Pero Antić on being named a Rising Star
quotes.excerpt: I was a Rising Star at 31 years old. I was already a falling star.
quotes.quote: I was a Rising Star at 31 years old. I was already a falling star. Everyone was laughing, including my mom and dad. I told them, 'Where is my Rising Star award? I'm already a falling star at 31.'
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Bio sam 'Rising Star' sa 31 godinom. Već sam bio 'falling star'. Svi su se smejali, uključujući moju mamu i tatu. Rekao sam im: 'Gde je moja nagrada za 'Rising Star'? Ja sam već 'falling star' sa 31 godinom.'

quotes.speaker: Pero Antić
quotes.summary_phrase: Pero Antić on playing through injury against the Memphis Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: I was playing against the Memphis Grizzlies, and my back was killing me.
quotes.quote: I was playing against the Memphis Grizzlies, and my back was killing me. I could barely get on the bus. It was nothing, just a hit to the ribs, but it hurt like hell. I told the coach that I couldn't play, but he insisted that I play. I played, and we won.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Igrao sam protiv Memfis Grizlisa, a leđa su me ubijala. Jedva sam mogao da uđem u autobus. Nije bilo ništa, samo udarac u rebra, ali bolelo je kao đavo. Rekao sam treneru da ne mogu da igram, ali on je insistirao da igram. Igrao sam i pobedili smo.

quotes.speaker: Pero Antić
quotes.summary_phrase: Pero Antić on Kobe Bryant's influence
quotes.excerpt: I played against Kobe Bryant the whole time. When I play against the Lakers, I play against Kyrie Irving.
quotes.quote: I played against Kobe Bryant the whole time. When I play against the Lakers, I play against Kyrie Irving. I don't want to carry his ego. Everyone has an ego, but Kobe was different. He was crazy about basketball. I had a shot to win against the Lakers, and I missed. I fouled him, and he just looked at me. I'm a good guy, but I was just trying to play basketball.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Igrao sam protiv Kobija Brajanta celo vreme. Kada igram protiv Lejkersa, igram protiv Kajri Irvinga. Ne želim da nosim njegov ego. Svako ima ego, ali Kobi je bio drugačiji. Bio je lud za košarkom. Imao sam šut za pobedu protiv Lejkersa i promašio sam. Faulirao sam ga, a on me je samo pogledao. Ja sam dobar momak, ali samo sam pokušavao da igram košarku.

quotes.speaker: Pero Antić
quotes.excerpt: Dwight Howard exhausted me. I never learned that third step to do it right.
quotes.quote: Dwight Howard exhausted me. I never learned that third step to do it right. I couldn't do it like him. He was a beast. He exhausted me. I don't give up, I'm strong, but he was just too much.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Dvajt Hauard me je iscrpeo. Nikada nisam naučio taj treći korak da to uradim kako treba. Nisam mogao da radim kao on. Bio je zver. Iscrpeo me je. Ne odustajem, jak sam, ali on je jednostavno bio previše.

quotes.speaker: Pero Antić
quotes.excerpt: Yuri Broyke was a legend. LeBron James doesn't watch the NBA, he watches other things.
quotes.quote: Yuri Broyke was a legend. LeBron James doesn't watch the NBA, he watches other things. I don't watch the NBA, I watch some games. I can't watch them, they've become like girls. They're always looking for something, falling, acting. LeBron James has ruined the NBA in a way.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Juri Brojke je bio legenda. Lebron Džejms ne gleda NBA, on gleda druge stvari. Ja ne gledam NBA, gledam neke utakmice. Ne mogu da ih gledam, postali su kao devojčice. Stalno nešto traže, padaju, glume. Lebron Džejms je na neki način upropastio NBA.

quotes.speaker: Pero Antić
quotes.summary_phrase: Pero Antić on his arrest in New York
quotes.excerpt: I was arrested in New York because I didn't want to move from the scene.
quotes.quote: I was arrested in New York because I didn't want to move from the scene. I was with my friends, and the police told us to move. I didn't want to move, and they arrested me. It was a big misunderstanding. I was just trying to protect my friends.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Uhapšen sam u Njujorku jer nisam hteo da se pomerim sa lica mesta. Bio sam sa prijateljima, a policija nam je rekla da se pomerimo. Nisam hteo da se pomerim i uhapsili su me. Bio je to veliki nesporazum. Samo sam pokušavao da zaštitim svoje prijatelje.

quotes.speaker: Pero Antić
quotes.summary_phrase: Pero Antić on writing a biography
quotes.excerpt: I don't want to write a biography. I'm afraid I'll have to tell the truth.
quotes.quote: I don't want to write a biography. I'm afraid I'll have to tell the truth. And if I tell the truth, there will be a lot of problems. I don't want to lie, and I don't want to write a book full of lies. So, no biography for me.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Ne želim da pišem biografiju. Plašim se da ću morati da kažem istinu. A ako kažem istinu, biće mnogo problema. Ne želim da lažem, a ne želim ni da pišem knjigu punu laži. Dakle, ništa od biografije za mene.
